name: robots/rickstaa__ros-gazebo-gym
title: ROS Gazebo Gym PandaReach-v1 (Franka Panda reach, simulated)
intro: ROS Gazebo Gym PandaReach-v1 (Franka Panda reach, simulated), adapted from rickstaa/ros-gazebo-gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
